title: Smoke Test — Refund in Payments Panel (Phase A)
subtitle: Stripe refund relocated into the Manage-Order payments panel; partial + repeatable refunds, with the offline boundary

meta.Flow: Manage order → Payments panel → Refund (partial $40 of $100) → reopen showing $60 remaining
meta.Change: OrderPaymentManagement: panel-level Refund button (reuses existing RefundOrderModal), guarded to Stripe orders
meta.Data note: Stripe keys in dev are placeholders (pk_test_xxx) — no live Stripe. Order O-ENANEOF was DB-seeded to $100 and the post-refund state (Refunded $40 / PARTIALLY_REFUNDED) was DB-seeded to capture the 'after' visual. The Stripe processing itself is pre-existing behavior, not part of this change. Order restored to originals afterward.

steps.title: 1 · Refund button now lives in the Payments panel
steps.description: Open a refundable Stripe order ($100, settled). The panel header shows Owed $100 / Collected $100 / SETTLED, and the new red Refund button sits beside the balance — this is the change.
steps.notes: Guard mirrors the OrdersTable kebab: payment_provider === 'STRIPE' && not free && not awaiting-offline && not already fully refunded.

steps.title: 2 · Refund opens the existing modal — full refund default
steps.description: Clicking Refund opens RefundOrderModal (reused unchanged). Order Total $100, Available to Refund $100, amount prefilled to the full balance ('Full refund').

steps.title: 3 · Enter $40 → partial refund detected ($40 of $100)
steps.description: Typing 40 flips the field description to 'Partial refund' and shows the blue confirmation alert: 'The customer will be refunded 40.00 USD.' Directly answers: yes, you can refund $40 of a $100 Stripe payment.

steps.title: 4 · After the $40 refund — $60 collected, button persists
steps.description: Post-refund panel: Owed $100 / Collected $60 / Refunded $40 / Outstanding $40. The Refund button is STILL present — partial refunds are repeatable against the remainder.
steps.notes: State DB-seeded (total_refunded=40, refund_status=PARTIALLY_REFUNDED) since dev Stripe is a placeholder. Balance math is pre-existing OrderBalanceService: a refund adds back to the receivable, so Outstanding reads $40.

steps.title: 5 · Reopen Refund — only $60 now available
steps.description: Reopening the modal shows Order Total $100, Already Refunded −$40, Available to Refund $60. The max enforces the remaining refundable amount.

steps.title: 6 · Boundary — offline order has NO Refund button
steps.description: An OFFLINE order's Payments panel (Owed $1.57 / Outstanding $1.57) shows no Refund button. Offline money is corrected via per-row Reverse (Phase B) or offline-refund recording (Phase C), never a Stripe refund.
